rows.05:d234:
Once the relief hit, my legs gave out.
I couldn't move for a while.
Okura ended up listed as missing.
I couldn't exactly tell anyone the truth.
Well, he was just an idiot.
He got what was coming to him.{p}Alright, that's the end of my story.
Time for the sixth one at last.{p}
rows.05:e690:
There was a tiny creature there, the size of a ping-pong ball.
Half of its head was a skull, and the woman's face on the other half was gazing happily at {f:me|me}.
Tentacles were writhing beneath the face.
No one but {f:me|me} had noticed it, but still.
{f:It was|It was} the woman from the cards.
{f:They really did come back|So they really came back}.
And {f:I|I}'d gone out of my way to throw myself in front of {f:those things|those women}, like a {f:total idiot|complete fool}.
Everything seemed to go dark before my eyes.{p}Since {f:I|I} had gone silent, someone else spoke up in my place.
"Well then, time for the sixth story."{p}
